name: Dutasteride
summary: A prescription capsule that blocks DHT production, approved in the US for an enlarged prostate; it is used off-label for male pattern hair loss.
what_it_is: Dutasteride is a 5-alpha-reductase inhibitor that blocks both the type 1 and type 2 enzymes that convert testosterone into DHT, cutting blood DHT by about 85% to 95%. It lasts a long time in the body: its half-life is about 5 weeks, and it can be detected for 4 to 6 months after stopping. It lowers PSA by about half within 3 to 6 months.

evidence.why: FDA-approved for a symptomatic enlarged prostate; for hair loss (off-label in the US), a meta-analysis of 3 short randomized trials in 576 men found more hair growth than with finasteride.

status_us.label: FDA-approved for enlarged prostate; off-label for hair
status_us.note: Approved for symptomatic benign prostatic hyperplasia in men with an enlarged prostate, alone or with tamsulosin; the label says it is not approved to prevent prostate cancer. Use for hair loss is off-label in the US.

benefits.claim: Improves symptoms of an enlarged prostate and lowers the risk of acute urinary retention and BPH surgery
Increased hair counts more than finasteride, with better photo ratings, in men with male pattern hair loss (3 randomized trials, 576 men, 24 weeks; off-label)

risks.risk: Sexual side effects in the first 6 months: impotence (4.7% versus 1.7% on placebo), lower libido (3.0% versus 1.4%) and ejaculation problems (1.4% versus 0.5%); rates generally fell after the first year, some may persist after stopping, and guidelines say men should be told about them before starting
Breast enlargement or tenderness; reports after approval of male breast cancer, depressed mood, and testicular pain or swelling
Higher chance that a prostate cancer, if found, is high grade: Gleason 8 to 10 cancer in 1.0% versus 0.5% on placebo in the REDUCE trial
Lower semen volume (26%), total sperm count (23%) and sperm motility (18%) after a year; total sperm count had not recovered after 24 weeks of follow-up, and the effect on fertility is unknown
Possible suicidal thoughts: in 2025 EU regulators found insufficient evidence of a causal link but added the potential risk to labeling as a precaution, given a possible class effect

avoid_if: Women who are or may be pregnant: must not take it or handle leaking capsules, since it is absorbed through the skin and can harm a male fetus
Women and children (not approved for them)
Past serious allergic reaction to dutasteride or another 5-alpha-reductase inhibitor
Blood donors: no donating until at least 6 months after the last dose
interactions: Strong, long-term CYP3A4 inhibitors such as ritonavir or ketoconazole: can raise dutasteride levels

during: PSA: a new baseline after at least 3 months; any confirmed rise from the lowest value should be evaluated
labs.why: Dutasteride lowers PSA by about half, so the label calls for a new PSA baseline after at least 3 months of treatment and evaluation of any confirmed rise; no other routine labs are required.

studies.title: The efficacy and safety of dutasteride compared with finasteride in treating men with androgenetic alopecia: a systematic review and meta-analysis
studies.people: 576 men with male pattern hair loss in 3 randomized trials (24 weeks)
studies.finding: Dutasteride increased hair counts and photo ratings more than finasteride, with similar rates of sexual side effects; the authors noted the trials were few and short.

studies.title: AVODART (dutasteride) capsules: Prescribing Information
studies.people: Men with an enlarged prostate, and men in the REDUCE prostate cancer prevention trial
studies.finding: Sexual side effects were more common than with placebo early on and declined over time; in REDUCE, high-grade prostate cancer was more common (1.0% versus 0.5%).

studies.title: Management of Lower Urinary Tract Symptoms Attributed to Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia: AUA Guideline
studies.people: Men with urinary symptoms from an enlarged prostate
studies.finding: Recommends 5-alpha-reductase inhibitors for men with an enlarged prostate, and says clinicians should tell patients about sexual side effects before starting.

ask_your_clinician: Given how long dutasteride stays in the body, what should I know about side effects, PSA tests and blood donation?
Which sexual or mood changes should I report?
If my goal is hair loss, how does off-label dutasteride compare with approved options?

notes_for_editor: Label is the October 2023 Avodart label as reprinted by Drugs.com. The hair-loss evidence is a meta-analysis of 3 trials lasting 24 weeks; long-term hair data were not opened, and dutasteride's approval for hair loss in some other countries was not confirmed this round. The meta-analysis reports conflicting p-values for erectile dysfunction (0.70 in the text, 0.07 in the abstract). The EMA review (May 2025) found insufficient evidence for a causal link with suicidal thoughts but added the potential risk to EU labels; the US label lists depressed mood only as a postmarketing report. The AUA guideline excerpt read did not name individual 5-alpha-reductase inhibitors.
